messages.content:
No `libexpat` on the system, but `apt-get` is available. Let me try installing it, and as a fallback, check for GDAL or use `tifffile`/`PIL` approaches.

```python
import subprocess

# Try installing libexpat1
res = subprocess.run(["bash", "-lc", "apt-get install -y libexpat1 2>&1 | tail -5 || sudo apt-get install -y libexpat1 2>&1 | tail -5"],
                     capture_output=True, text=True)
print(res.stdout)
print(res.stderr)

# Fallback checks
print("gdalinfo:", subprocess.run(["bash", "-lc", "which gdalinfo"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout)
print("python gdal:", subprocess.run(["bash", "-lc", "python -c 'from osgeo import gdal; print(gdal.__version__)' 2>&1"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout)
```
